cards.ex: I'll get back to you with the details tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Men sizga tafsilotlarni ertaga yuboraman.
cards.uzDef: Keyinroq javob berish yoki xabar yuborish.

cards.ex: Let's wrap up the meeting and decide on the next steps.
cards.exUz: Yig'ilishni tugatamiz va keyingi qadamlarni hal qilamiz.

cards.ex: Bear with me while I try to find the document.
cards.exUz: Hujjatni topishga harakat qilayotganimda, ozgina sabr qiling.
cards.uzDef: Ozroq sabr qilishni so'rash, tushunmovchilik uchun.

cards.ex: Per our conversation, I'm sending you the report.
cards.exUz: Suhbatimizga ko'ra, men sizga hisobotni yuboryapman.

cards.ex: I've attached the proposal for your consideration.
cards.exUz: Men sizga taklifni ko'rib chiqishingiz uchun ilova qildim.
cards.uzDef: E'tiborga olishni so'rash, qaror qabul qilish uchun.

cards.ex: Let's circle back on this issue next week.
cards.exUz: Keling, bu masalaga keyingi hafta qaytib bog'lanamiz.
cards.uzDef: Keyinroq yana aloqaga chiqish yoki mavzuga qaytish.

cards.ex: She's very down to earth despite her fame.
cards.exUz: U mashhurligiga qaramay, juda oddiy.

cards.ex: Can you give me a ballpark figure for the project cost?
cards.exUz: Loyiha narxi uchun taxminiy raqam bera olasizmi?

cards.ex: In a nutshell, the project was a success.
cards.exUz: Qisqacha aytganda, loyiha muvaffaqiyatli bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qisqa va aniq qilib bayon qilish.

cards.ex: He always goes the extra mile to help his colleagues.
cards.exUz: U hamkasblariga yordam berish uchun doimo qo'shimcha harakat qiladi.

cards.ex: I appreciated her straightforward manner when she gave feedback.
cards.exUz: Men uning fikr-mulohazalarini berganida, uning ochiq usulini qadrladim.

cards.ex: The meeting ran late, as per usual.
cards.exUz: Yig'ilish har doimgidek kechga qoldi.

cards.ex: Please peruse the document before signing it.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, hujjatni imzolashdan oldin uni diqqat bilan o'qing.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni diqqat bilan va batafsil o'qib chiqish.

cards.ex: You will receive a response in due course.
cards.exUz: Siz o'z vaqtida javob olasiz.

cards.ex: We will do our best to expedite your request.
cards.exUz: Biz sizning so'rovingizni tezlashtirish uchun bor kuchimizni sarflaymiz.

cards.ex: We endeavor to provide the best possible service.
cards.exUz: Biz eng yaxshi xizmatni ko'rsatishga harakat qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Urinish, harakat qilish, maqsadga erishishga intilish.

cards.ex: He was, as it were, the life of the party.
cards.exUz: U, go'yo, kechaning joni edi.
cards.uzDef: Taxmin yoki taqqoslashni kiritish uchun ishlatiladi.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all competitors.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha raqobatchilar uchun teng sharoit yaratishimiz kerak.

cards.ex: Okay, let's get down to business and discuss the agenda.
cards.exUz: Xo'sh, ishga kirishamiz va kun tartibini muhokama qilamiz.

cards.ex: "Can I borrow your pen?" "By all means."
cards.exUz: "Sizning ruchkangizni olsam bo'ladimi?" "Albatta."

cards.ex: I'll keep you in the loop regarding any changes.
cards.exUz: Men sizni har qanday o'zgarishlar haqida xabardor qilaman.
cards.term: I'll keep you in the loop

cards.ex: Let's touch base offline to discuss this in more detail.
cards.exUz: Keling, buni batafsilroq muhokama qilish uchun offlayn uchrashamiz.

cards.ex: Just so you know, the deadline has been extended.
cards.exUz: Bilishingiz uchun, muddat uzaytirildi.

cards.ex: Feel free to reach out if you have any questions.
cards.exUz: Savollaringiz bo'lsa, bemalol bog'lanishingiz mumkin.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project.
cards.exUz: Keling, ushbu loyihani boshlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlash, jarayonni yo'lga qo'yish.

cards.ex: I'm writing to you on behalf of the company.
cards.exUz: Men sizga kompaniya nomidan yozmoqdaman.

cards.ex: Please reply to this email at your earliest convenience.
cards.exUz: Iltimos, ushbu elektron pochtaga imkon qadar tezroq javob bering.
cards.uzDef: Tezroq bajarishni so'rash, lekin talab qilmasdan.

cards.ex: As a rule of thumb, you should allow extra time for commuting.
cards.exUz: Odatdagidek, qatnov uchun qo'shimcha vaqt ajratishingiz kerak.

cards.ex: Just a heads up, the office will be closed tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Shunchaki ogohlantirish, ofis ertaga yopiq bo'ladi.

cards.ex: The situation was, to put it mildly, difficult.
cards.exUz: Vaziyat, yumshoq qilib aytganda, qiyin edi.
